interface.adapterScope: one adapter per prototype; admit/project dispatched per effect instance and per path; prototype status is a default only; unknown prototype rejected

output.directFacts: DirectFactRowV1[] evaluable fact rows: schemaVersion, factType, key, sourceActionId, sourceActorId, sourceEffectId, targetIds, amount, unit, durationTurns; declared magnitudes only, no mitigation/hit final settlement; column-code strings are not contributions
output.legalityModifiers: target-legality modifiers derived from current public state only (taunt source constraint, control cancellation, disarm or silence rules, state migration and erasure of taunt or control); forced taunt target set is sorted UTF-16 ascending; unique-target mechanisms with more than one taunter reject AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET
output.opportunityModifiers: opportunity identity and distribution modifiers (judgment rates, interference rates, resource locks) that enter candidate dependency tokens; declared magnitudes; mechanicMetadataEntries holds per-effect-instance projection metadata (one closed entry per effect instance) (sourceEffectId plus prototype-allowed Chinese field-name keys 生效方式/结算标签/抗性类型/驱动属性/影响方向/对应等级) as verbatim normalized deep clones that are deep-frozen and never used for scoring/weighting; projectionFamilies (batch-2 routing identity: [{sourceEffectId, prototype}]) is audit-only routing metadata, never a weight
output.scheduledFacts: S5 scheduled and window facts (delayed triggers, duration adjustments, follow-up or summon window grants); every scheduled fact row carries stable entryId = ${sourceEffectId}:schedule:${index} where index is the 0-based position inside that effect instance's own scheduledFacts array, covering WINDOW_ADJUST/SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST/FOLLOW_UP/SUMMON_WINDOW; WINDOW_ADJUST uses only entryId/operation/调整字段/调整方式 plus, when present, 调整回合/调整tick/调整次数/结算倍率 (private aliases key/字段/方式 are forbidden); SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST uses entryId/operation/结算倍率; FOLLOW_UP uses entryId/grantType/ownerId/followUpKey/triggerKey/maxActions (ownerId is the unique targetId after effect target closure; V1 never fans out: zero or multiple targets are deferred/unsupported, with FOLLOW_UP_RECIPIENT_COUNT_INVALID and no grant row; followUpKey comes only from explicit 跟进行动键 and missing key is fail-closed as FOLLOW_UP_KEY_MISSING with no closed grant row; 主动触发 requires maxActions from explicit 可用次数, 随下次行动触发 projects no maxActions)/payloadDirectFacts; SUMMON_WINDOW uses entryId/grantType/召唤单位类型/召唤物名称/行动模式/durationTurns when known
output.unsupportedOutcomeKinds: outcome kinds this adapter cannot project; non-empty only together with deferCode or an explicit reason code
output.deferCode: per-path defer code; empty string when the path is fully supported

project.candidateRetention: deferred candidates retain vector coverage and candidateAudit reason

effectSource.meaning: optional provenance marker for the effect position; ITEM_USE_EFFECT marks an effect unpacked from an item 使用效果 container; absent defaults to CANDIDATE_DECLARATION; never used for scoring

pendingProjection.policy: condition branches, trigger limits, 变身期间 duration and unsigned percent magnitudes that the adapter cannot adjudicate from public immediate input produce explicit pending entries in unsupportedOutcomeKinds with retainedInCandidateAudit true and no unconditional facts; pending is not INVALID_OPTION_VALUE: mechanically valid input is never disguised as mechanical illegality; 状态移除 with a specific 状态 but missing or non-finite 数量 is mechanically legal but not directly numericizable => PENDING_DIRECT_PROJECTION with zero rows (never INTERNAL/NaN and never a fabricated default amount); only an explicit legal 数量 yields STATE_DELTA rows; tauntRemoved legality is emitted only when the 嘲讽/控制 semantics actually match; 决策干扰 影响方向 成功率 is a formal legal enum value (索敌干扰 indeed targets success rate), unknown values still INVALID_OPTION_VALUE

revision 4 directFacts supersede factColumns: every SUPPORTED effect projection must have at least one non-empty of directFacts/legalityModifiers/opportunityModifiers/scheduledFacts, otherwise unsupportedOutcomeKinds with an explicit reason code; column-name-only projection is forbidden; same-effect multi-values are separate rows with distinct frozen keys (damage.power/damage.segments/damage.penetration/damage.type, state.primary/state.secondary, window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio); row uniqueness is (sourceEffectId, key)

revision 4 whitelists and numeric forms: per-prototype field whitelists are rev5Spec.fieldWhitelists (live registry allowed fields unioned with actual fields of the A+B formal library union, 3057 classified effects; source B adds zero whitelist-new fields); 数值 is a percent string or a finite number (signed percent => PERCENT, unsigned percent => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION, number => ABS, plain numeric strings rejected INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); 防御穿透 is a finite number or percent string (both PERCENT); 持续回合 is a nonnegative integer or 变身期间 (变身期间 => PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION, no fabricated turns); fields not in the whitelist (e.g. 延迟回合/打断效果) are rejected; 对应等级 is a finite number only and generates no default when absent

机制授予 scheduled fact carries ownerId, followUpKey, triggerKey, maxActions and payload DirectFactRowV1 rows projected recursively from 授予效果; ownerId is the unique targetId after effect target closure and V1 never fans out: zero or multiple targets are deferred/unsupported, with FOLLOW_UP_RECIPIENT_COUNT_INVALID and no grant row; followUpKey is the nonempty opaque raw field 跟进行动键 only, never triggerKey, prototype name, skill name or display text; missing 跟进行动键 is fail-closed as FOLLOW_UP_KEY_MISSING and emits no closed grant row; triggerKey follows the registry enum 主动触发/随下次行动触发 only (死亡时触发 is INVALID_OPTION_VALUE) and is not followUpKey; maxActions comes only from explicit 可用次数 on 主动触发, missing 可用次数 rejects MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD (no default 1), 随下次行动触发 forbids 可用次数 per runtime and projects no maxActions; entryId remains the authenticated grant evidence identity and is the only V1 grantProofId source; unprojectable nested payload defers or marks unsupported with reason; bare creation carriers (empty/missing 授予效果, or 召唤生成 without summon identity 召唤单位类型/召唤物名称) are UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK and the caller unpacks and uses the contained effects

multi-taunt: the full forced taunt target set sorted by UTF-16 code unit ascending forms the legal target set; when the mechanism requires a unique taunt target and more than one exists, reject AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET

DirectFactRowV1 amount must be finite (JSON schema plus runtime validator); targetIds must be actual candidate target ids; empty or symbolic placeholders are rejected; all IDs (sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/targetIds) are non-empty, at most 512 characters, allow CJK/hyphen/space and reject C0 control characters and DEL

source and target context is required: sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/candidateTargetIds missing in legalityContext reject admit with MISSING_SOURCE_CONTEXT or MISSING_TARGET_CONTEXT; explicit unsupported otherwise

target resolution: effect 目标 自身 resolves to [sourceActorId]; 单体/群体/全场/召唤物/目标 and 分身 (for prototypes whose registry allows 分身) resolve to candidateTargetIds; Provider/adapter must not re-enumerate the candidate set; unknown target value rejects INVALID_OPTION_VALUE

revision 5 batch-2 whitelists: 状态施加/召唤生成/结算修正 field whitelists are rev5Spec.fieldWhitelists closed by the A inventory (状态施加 13 fields, 召唤生成 11 fields, 结算修正 13 fields); fields outside the whitelist are rejected

revision 5 state projection: signed 数值/副数值 => state.primary/state.secondary PERCENT rows; BOOL presence rows use the state name as key; unsigned => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION; 条件分支/触发限制/非立即触发 => explicit pending; taunt legality unchanged

revision 5 summon projection: summon.count/summon.strength/summon.duration/summon.inheritRatio rows emitted only when the field exists; 数量 must be positive (INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); 持续回合 missing or 变身期间 never fabricates turns (PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION, scheduled window without durationTurns); carrier stays upstream unpack (UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK), PDA never recurses

revision 5 settlement projection: single STATE_DELTA row key settlement.primary unit PERCENT; no HP/RESOURCE double rows from the same effect; 限定元素 array UTF-16 ascending in mechanicMetadataEntries; declared magnitude is never a final settlement claim

revision 5 projectionFamilies: opportunityModifiers.projectionFamilies [{sourceEffectId, prototype}] is routing identity for the feature compiler; prototype names are never weighted and never enter values

revision 5 summon carrier identity (EITHER rule): admit/project requires all four identity fields (sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/candidateTargetIds) non-empty on the summon effect instance; ANY missing identity field makes the carrier fail-closed UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK with no partial rows and no fabricated identity; identity gaps are never INVALID_OPTION_VALUE and never silent; PDA never recurses into carriers

numericForms.数值: signed or unsigned percent string or finite number; signed percent => PERCENT with sign, unsigned percent => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION (direction uninferable), number => ABS; plain numeric strings without unit rejected INVALID_OPTION_VALUE; 状态施加/结算修正 数值 is a signed percent string (signed => PERCENT, unsigned => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION); 结算修正 never emits HP/RESOURCE rows from the same effect
numericForms.防御穿透: finite number or percent string; both normalize to PERCENT
numericForms.持续回合: nonnegative integer or 变身期间; integer => TURNS, 变身期间 => PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION, no fabricated turn count
numericForms.数量: 召唤生成 数量 must be a positive integer; non-positive or non-integer rejects INVALID_OPTION_VALUE; unit COUNT
numericForms.强度: 召唤生成 强度 finite number => RATIO (raw, no clamp); plain numeric strings rejected INVALID_OPTION_VALUE
numericForms.继承属性比例: 召唤生成 继承属性比例 finite number => RATIO (raw)

pendingProjection.policy: explicit pending in unsupportedOutcomeKinds with retainedInCandidateAudit; no unconditional facts; never INVALID_OPTION_VALUE for mechanically valid input; PENDING13 prototypes (not yet DIRECT-projected among the 581 supported paths) use PENDING_DIRECT_PROJECTION as their pending kind

element.sourceEffectId: effect instance id of the projected row
element.prototype: prototype name of the source effect

projectionFamilies.purpose: audit identity mapping for feature family routing only: batch-2 projections (状态施加/召唤生成/结算修正) MUST carry one entry per distinct sourceEffectId of their directFacts rows; the prototype name is routing identity and is NEVER a weight, score input or special case for value projection
projectionFamilies.scope: required on batch-2 prototypes; optional elsewhere (row-shape routing fallback)

状态施加.magnitude: signed 数值 => STATE_DELTA row key state.primary unit PERCENT; signed 副数值 => row key state.secondary; unsigned percent => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION; missing 数值 with a state name => BOOL presence row (key = state name, unit BOOL, amount 1, durationTurns from 持续回合 or 0)
状态施加.pending: 条件分支 => PENDING_CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION; 触发限制 => PENDING_TRIGGER_PROJECTION; 触发方式 other than 立即触发 => PENDING_TRIGGER_PROJECTION
状态施加.metadata: 生效方式/驱动属性/影响方向/对应等级/触发方式 go to mechanicMetadataEntries; 跟随主原型 preserved as metadata only
状态施加.legality: taunt keeps the frozen legality: legalityModifiers.taunt {state,target} + forced taunt target set UTF-16 sorted; AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET when unique-target mechanism has >1 taunter
状态施加.duration: 持续回合 nonnegative integer => durationTurns; missing => 0 (no fabrication); 变身期间 => PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION

召唤生成.rows: 数量 positive integer => SUMMON_WINDOW row key summon.count unit COUNT; 强度 finite number => summon.strength unit RATIO; 继承属性比例 finite number => summon.inheritRatio unit RATIO; each row emitted only when the field exists; summon.inheritRatio is a distinct row and is NEVER merged into summon.strength (downstream it maps to no feature code and only counts into OUTSIDE_BATCH1_ROW_COUNT)
召唤生成.duration: 持续回合 nonnegative integer => summon.duration row unit TURNS and scheduled window durationTurns; missing or 变身期间 => NO fabricated turns: no summon.duration row, scheduled window without durationTurns, PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION
召唤生成.count: 数量 non-positive or non-integer => INVALID_OPTION_VALUE
召唤生成.scheduled: all scheduledFacts entries (WINDOW_ADJUST/SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST/FOLLOW_UP/SUMMON_WINDOW) carry stable entryId = `${sourceEffectId}:schedule:${index}` where index is the 0-based position of the scheduled entry inside this effect instance's own scheduledFacts array; summon entry keeps 召唤单位类型/召唤物名称/行动模式 and window durationTurns when known; identity without fabricated window
召唤生成.pending: 触发限制 => PENDING_TRIGGER_PROJECTION; carrier identity is fail-closed EITHER rule: all four identity fields (sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId/candidateTargetIds) must be non-empty on the summon effect instance, and ANY missing identity field => UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK with no partial rows (never INVALID_OPTION_VALUE, never silent); carrier without 召唤单位类型 or 召唤物名称 => UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK (caller unpacks, PDA never recurses)
召唤生成.metadata: 生效方式/触发限制 go to mechanicMetadataEntries verbatim when the source field exists (perPrototypeSubsets 召唤生成 = [生效方式, 触发限制]); audit-only: values never enter feature values; 触发限制 presence still sends row projection to PENDING_TRIGGER_PROJECTION

结算修正.row: signed 数值 => STATE_DELTA row key settlement.primary unit PERCENT signed, durationTurns from 持续回合 (missing => 0); unsigned => PENDING_DIRECTION_PROJECTION
结算修正.noDoubleCount: the same effect never emits HP_DELTA/RESOURCE_OPTION_CHANGED rows; settlement.primary is the only row family
结算修正.metadata: 结算/限定元素/吸收资源/吸收来源/生效方式/影响方向/驱动属性/对应等级 go to mechanicMetadataEntries verbatim, each key copied ONLY when its source field exists; no fabricated keys or default values (absence of 生效方式 never invents one); 限定元素 normalized to a string array sorted UTF-16 ascending (single string => one-element array)
结算修正.futureValue: declared magnitude is a modifier, never a final settlement claim; SETTLEMENT_DAMAGE stays ALWAYS_UNKNOWN downstream

pending13Projection.policy: PENDING13 是 581 支持路径中尚未 DIRECT 投影的 13 个原型：机械合法的正式字段一律 admitted=true + unsupportedOutcomeKinds=[PENDING_DIRECT_PROJECTION] + retainedInCandidateAudit=true + deferCode=空 + 零 directFacts（可携带机械合法性/机会修正）；仅未知键、未知枚举、非法值形态才 INVALID_OPTION_VALUE；缺 registry required 字段 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD；规则改写/规则防御未知规则 UNKNOWN_RULE；机制授予无授予效果 UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK，授予效果内嵌 defer 原型（复制执行/时光回溯）DEFER_MECHANICS_PROJECTION + payloadKind；时窗修正 调整方式=延长 且携带 结算倍率 冲突 INVALID_OPTION_VALUE；未知原型不落入本表 UNKNOWN_PROTOTYPE_REJECTED。
pending13Projection.registrySource: MVU_Skill_Runtime.js SKILL_PROTOTYPE_DEFINITION_LIST_V1（allowed/required）∪ 通用字段 原型/目标/生效方式；枚举来自 SKILL_PROTOTYPE_FIELD_OPTIONS_V1 与 读取原型字段选项_V1 按原型覆盖（VM 验证导出）；值形态来自 SKILL_PROTOTYPE_FIELD_TYPE_V1。合同领先模块一步：模块 MECH16_ALLOWED 后续按本表落盘。

valueTypes.跟进行动键: 非空不透明字符串；缺失使 admit fail-closed 为 FOLLOW_UP_KEY_MISSING，不得生成闭合 FOLLOW_UP row

mechanicMetadataEntries.valuePolicy: values are verbatim normalized deep clones of the effect field values, deep-frozen; consumers must not mutate or weight them; entries are audit-only and never enter feature values
mechanicMetadataEntries.entryShape: closed entries array: one entry per effect instance, each {sourceEffectId, <prototype-allowed Chinese field-name keys>}; the singular mechanicMetadataEntries object is removed; no union/compatibility shape is kept anywhere
